notes: API-backed animated icon using Lottie. Fetches JSON at build time, inlines as animationData. Pipeline routes to Icon atom in reduced/textonly. Decorative instances (no label) hidden in textonly.

content._description: What this icon is and what it represents

slug.description: Asset Library slug for the Lottie JSON.

fallbackIcon.description: Phosphor icon name for static fallback in reduced/textonly.

label.description: Human-readable label. Required for navigation role. Optional for informational.

role.description: Decorative = aria-hidden, hidden in textonly. Informational = shows static fallback icon in textonly. Navigation = shows static fallback + text label in textonly (requires label + fallbackIcon).

color.description: Colour override. native = keeps Lottie baked colours. Any other forces currentColor.

animation._description: Motion behaviour — stripped in reduced render

trigger.description: Animation trigger. none=static, autoplay=once, loop=continuous, hover=play on hover/focus/click, viewport=play on scroll into view, interval=play 3x then pause.

interval.description: Gap in ms between interval bursts (default 3s).
